content.comment_body: Hello, I found a potential solution, but I want the user to change only one temperature value (for example, on the text display). The hysteresis should remain fixed at 1 degree. Has anyone implemented a method where setpoint OFF or ON is calculated automatically? [url]
You can use the analog threshold trigger and set its delta parameter to -10 (which represents 1.0 °C). This way, you only need to adjust the ON parameter.
How do you modify the 'delta' parameter? I don't see this option in the analog threshold trigger function block. Thanks, [user_name]
Disregard my previous question. I now realize it is a parameter in the analog differential function block.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants focus on making temperature control simpler by allowing users to adjust just one setpoint, keeping hysteresis constant. There is confusion about which function block allows direct access to the 'delta' parameter for hysteresis, with clarification that it is found in the differential function block, not the threshold one.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the ability to adjust one temperature setpoint with a fixed hysteresis and expect straightforward access to relevant parameters directly within the software or display interface.
